boundaries.description: The useful boundary is between preparing an inspectable work product and making a consequential professional decision.

faq.title: AI workspace questions for teachers and education teams
faq.description: The practical questions concern sources, review, privacy, and control—not promises of one-click professional work.

items.question: Is Floatboat specialized software for this profession?
items.answer: No. Floatboat is a general-purpose Agent Workspace that helps teachers and education teams work with approved material and editable deliverables. It does not replace specialist systems or accountable professionals.

items.question: Can it make professional decisions?
items.answer: It should not. Use it to organize, compare, extract, and draft; keep interpretation, trade-offs, and consequential decisions with qualified people.

items.question: Can we use our own templates and standards?
items.answer: Yes. Configure work around approved templates, terminology, checklists, output formats, and review steps.

items.question: How do we reduce hallucinations and errors?
items.answer: Keep outputs tied to inspectable sources, preserve open questions, and require people to verify important facts, figures, claims, and conclusions.

items.question: How should sensitive information be handled?
items.answer: Follow organizational policy and applicable obligations, review the data handling of every model, tool, and connector, and grant the narrowest practical access.

items.question: Will it automatically send messages or publish work?
items.answer: Recommended workflows keep every external send, publication, submission, and consequential action behind explicit human approval.

items.question: What is the best first use case?
items.answer: Choose a repetitive task with a bounded source set and an output that is easy to inspect. Validate quality before saving the workflow or sharing it with a team.

finalCta.title: Give the repetitive preparation around teachers and education teams a better workspace.
finalCta.description: Choose a bounded working set, a trusted standard, and a deliverable that a person can review.
